findings.title: Renamed function breaks callers
findings.body: Renaming `readSensor` to `sampleSensor` breaks the import in `src/alerts.ts` on line 2, which still calls `readSensor`. Either keep the original name or update all callers to use `sampleSensor`.

summary.problem: Renaming `readSensor` to `sampleSensor` breaks existing callers without updating them.
summary.done_well: The function signature and implementation remain correct and unchanged.
